items.title: 9.3.4 Steps to Pitching Your Idea (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of pitching steps (PDF 215-216).

items: Masle se shuru: 'Yahan bohat log sehatmand khana chahte hain magar taza juice ke kam mauqe hain.'
Hal pesh karein: 'Hamari dukaan maqami phalon ke taza, sehatmand juice degi.'
Munfarid kyun: 'Doosri dukanon ke bar-aks hum sastay pan par tawajjo aur maqami kisanon ki madad karte hain.'
Sameen ko jaanein: gahak sunna chahte ke unhein kyun pasand aayega; investors sunna chahte ke paisa kaise banega.
Qeemat, jagah aur doosri tafseel ke sawalon ke liye tayyar rahein.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche paanch numbered dabbe, teeron se jure: 1. Masla (problem): taza juice ke mauqe kam hain. 2. Hal (solution): maqami phalon ke taza juice. 3. Munfarid kyun (unique): sasta, kisanon ki madad. 4. Sameen (audience): gahak ke liye kyun pasand, investor ke liye munafa. 5. Sawalon ke liye tayyar: qeemat, jagah, tafseel.
blocks.caption: Pitch ke paanch qadam, juice shop ki misal ke saath (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.text: Web development ki pitch: Masla: shehar ki kai chhoti dukanon aur restaurants ki website nahi aur gahak lana mushkil hai. Hal: un ke liye saada, sasti websites. Munfarid nukta: chhote karobaron ke liye banaye, aasan, maqami zaban ki sahoolat wale designs. Sameen: online maujoodgi chahne wale maqami dukaandar aur restaurant managers.

blocks.prompt: Mo-assar pitch ke aham ajza aur tayyari ka tareeqa bataiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Ajza: wazeh masla, aap ka hal, kya munfarid hai, sameen, aur investors ke liye paisa kaise banega. Tayyari: market aur muqabileen ki tehqeeq, isi tarteeb mein mukhtasar script, sunne walon ke mutabiq dhalna, saade visuals ya adad, wazeh aur waqt ke andar hone tak mashq, aur mumkina sawalat (qeemat, jagah, kharche) ke jawab tayyar.

items: Pitch ke qadam: masla, hal, munfarid pan, sameen, sawalon ke jawab.
